title: Lotus motif
subtitle: An eight-pointed lotus with shell petals and a puff centre, 11 cm
excerpt: The lotus motif uses eight shell-stitch petals worked outward from a puff-stitch centre, giving the characteristic cupped lotus outline. The petals are elongated fan shells that stand slightly upright due to the tension of the puff centre. At 11 cm in DK cotton it is a strong centrepiece for meditation cushions, bathroom textiles, and yoga-themed projects.
sourceNotes: Weldon's Practical Crochet, Volume 7 (1892), lotus and exotic flower motif chapter (Internet Archive). Therese de Dillmont, Encyclopedia of Needlework (1886), shell-stitch flower construction.
heroPrompt: A crochet lotus motif in pale ivory DK cotton with eight upright shell petals and a yellow puff stitch centre, 11 cm across, photographed flat on a pale blue background in soft daylight.

crochet.gaugeText: Each finished lotus motif measures 11 cm across in DK-weight cotton with a 4 mm hook.

chartDefinition.title: Lotus motif
chartDefinition.caption: Yellow puff centre from magic ring. Eight dc equally spaced for petal attachment points. Eight shell petals (5tr fan in ch-2 spaces). Dc border round.

glossaryTerms.definition: Multiple yarn-overs drawn up into tall loops and joined at the top, forming a plump raised bubble. Used at the lotus centre to mimic the seed pod.

content.text: centre in yellow or gold — eight puff stitches into a magic ring, separated by ch-2 spaces — then attaches eight ivory shell petals in the ch-2 spaces. The shells are five-treble fans that cup slightly inward due to the tight ch-2 attachment point. A final dc border round gives the outer edge a clean finish.

attrs.title: Materials for one motif
attrs.body: About 15 g of ivory DK cotton, 3 g of yellow or gold for the centre. A 4 mm hook. Tapestry needle. Scissors.

content.text: Each finished lotus motif measures 11 cm across in DK-weight cotton with a 4 mm hook.
chain (ch), slip stitch (sl st), magic ring (MR) — UK and US shared.
puff stitch — [yo, insert hook, pull up a loop] 4 times, yo, pull through all 9 loops.
shell (5tr in same sp) — five trebles into one space.
Form a magic ring. Ch 1. *Puff into ring. Ch 2.* Repeat 7 more times. Sl st to top of first puff. (8 puffs, 8 ch-2 spaces.) Pull ring tail to close. Fasten off yellow.
Join ivory to any ch-2 space. *Work 5tr (shell) into ch-2 sp. Ch 1. Dc into top of next puff. Ch 1.* Repeat 7 more times. Sl st to first tr to join. (8 shells, 8 dc.)
Ch 1. Dc into each tr of each shell and into each dc and ch-1 space around. Sl st to join. Fasten off.

definition.title: Lotus motif
definition.caption: Yellow centre: 8 puff stitches with ch-2 spaces in magic ring. Ivory petals: 5tr shell in each ch-2 space. Dc border round.

content.text: Fasten off and weave in ends. Steam-block the shells flat if they are cupping upward more than desired.
Handwash in cool water. Lay flat to dry. Re-steam-block the petal shells if needed.

The dahlia (crochet-flower-dahlia) uses a similar shell-in-concentric-rings construction at a larger scale. The sunflower (crochet-flower-sunflower) swaps the puff centre for a bobble centre for a different textural effect.
